nodes.content: single-image articulated objects are hard to convert into simulation-ready assets; image-to-3D and text-to-3D methods usually produce fused shapes rather than kinematic part meshes; appearance-driven part generation is not enough for motion-aware segmentation and URDF construction; template-free reconstruction needs part geometry and joint parameters from one RGB image

VLM can miscount object parts and produce over-segmented or under-segmented assets; VLM-generated part images can be texture-misaligned with the input; secondary joints such as handles and buttons are often missed; multi-DOF joints, compound mechanisms, and closed chains are outside the demonstrated scope; official GitHub repository is currently a placeholder without released source, checkpoints, training code, inference scripts, or preprocessed data
